JSON.parse(post.slides) : post.slides; const fit = (v, max) => { const t = String(v || '').trim(); return t.length <= max ? t : t.slice(0, max - 1).trimEnd() + '…'; }; const slides = raw.map((s, i) => { const base = { eyebrow: fit(s.eyebrow, 42), title: fit(s.title, 82), sourceLabel: fit(s.sourceLabel || post.source_authority || 'Finkavo source-backed guide', 80) }; if (i === 0) return { ...base, type: 'cover', category: 'Portugal finance', subtitle: fit(s.body, 150) }; if (i === raw.length - 1) return { ...base, type: 'summary', body: fit(s.body, 300), cta: fit(post.call_to_action, 80) }; return { ...base, type: 'content', body: fit(s.body, 420) }; }); return [{ json: { manifest: { schemaVersion: 1, postId: post.id, revisionId: 'approved-v1', locale: 'en', templateVersion: 'finkavo-v1', slides }, postId: post.id } }];
